visible_evidence: measuring cup filled with water
water level aligned with 12 oz mark

checks.text: Water is measured using a measuring container or scale

steps.text: Place-Place the dripper on top of a coffee mug
visible_evidence: hand setting dripper onto mug rim
dripper resting stably on top of coffee mug

checks.text: The dripper rests centered and stable on top of the coffee mug

visible_evidence: coffee beans placed in container on scale
scale display showing weight

checks.text: Coffee beans are placed on a kitchen scale

steps.text: Grind-Grind the coffee beans until the coffee grounds are the consistency of coarse sand, about 20 seconds
visible_evidence: coffee beans poured into grinder
grinder operating
coarse sand-like coffee grounds visible

checks.text: The coffee grounds have a coarse sand consistency
The grinder runs for approximately 20 seconds

steps.text: Prepare-Prepare the filter insert by folding the paper filter in half to create a semi-circle, and in half again to create a quarter-circle
visible_evidence: hands folding paper filter in half into a semi-circle
paper filter folded again into a quarter-circle wedge

checks.text: The paper filter is folded in half to form a semi-circle
The paper filter is folded a second time to form a quarter-circle

visible_evidence: pouring measured water into kettle opening
kettle containing water

checks.text: The measured water is poured into the kettle

steps.text: Place-Place the paper filter in the dripper
visible_evidence: hand inserting folded paper filter into dripper
paper filter seated inside dripper

checks.text: The folded paper filter is seated inside the dripper

steps.text: Boil-Boil the water. (While the water is boiling, assemble the filter cone)
visible_evidence: kettle switched on or placed on heated stove
steam rising or boiling indicator active on kettle

checks.text: The water in the kettle reaches a boil with visible steam or boiling indicator

steps.text: spread-spread open filter in dripper to create a cone
visible_evidence: fingers separating filter layers inside dripper
paper filter opened into a cone lining the dripper walls

checks.text: The paper filter is spread open into a cone shape lining the inside of the dripper

steps.text: check-Once the water has boiled, check the temperature of the water. (The water should be between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or between 91-96 degrees Celsius. If the water is too hot, let it cool briefly.)
visible_evidence: thermometer probe inserted into kettle water or kettle temperature display visible
temperature readout between 195-205 F or 91-96 C

checks.text: A thermometer or kettle display is used to check the water temperature
The displayed water temperature is between 195 and 205 degrees Fahrenheit or 91 and 96 degrees Celsius

steps.text: Transfer-Transfer the grounds to the filter cone
visible_evidence: spooning or pouring coffee grounds into paper filter cone
coffee grounds resting inside the filter cone

checks.text: The coffee grounds are placed inside the open paper filter cone

steps.text: Pour-Pour a small amount of water into the filter to wet the grounds
visible_evidence: kettle tilting to pour a small stream of water onto grounds
coffee grounds darkened and saturated with water

checks.text: A small amount of water wets the coffee grounds in the filter

steps.text: Wait-Wait about 30 seconds for the coffee to bloom. (You will see small bubbles or foam on the coffee grounds during this step.)
visible_evidence: pouring paused with kettle set aside
small bubbles or foam forming on top of wet coffee grounds

checks.text: Pouring pauses for approximately 30 seconds
Small bubbles or foam appear on the surface of the coffee grounds

steps.text: pour-Slowly pour the rest of the water over the grounds in a circular motion. Do not overfill beyond the top of the paper filter
visible_evidence: kettle moving in circular motion pouring water over grounds
water level staying below the top rim of the paper filter

checks.text: Water is poured slowly in a circular motion over the coffee grounds
The water level stays below the top edge of the paper filter

steps.text: drain-Let the coffee drain completely into the mug before removing the dripper
visible_evidence: dripper remaining on mug while coffee drips down
wet grounds with drained liquid level in filter
dripper lifted off mug after dripping finishes

checks.text: All liquid drains out of the filter into the mug before the dripper is lifted

steps.text: Discard-Discard the paper filter and coffee grounds
visible_evidence: hand lifting used paper filter with grounds out of dripper
filter and grounds dropped into trash or compost bin
empty dripper

checks.text: The used paper filter and coffee grounds are removed from the dripper and placed in a waste receptacle
